definitions.explanation: An international organization founded in 1945 to promote peace, security, and cooperation among nations.

examples.japanese: UN{総会|そうかい}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: The UN General Assembly was held.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}はUN{安保理|あんぽり}の{非常任理事国|ひじょうにんりじこく}だ。
examples.english: Japan is a non-permanent member of the UN Security Council.

examples.japanese: UNは{紛争|ふんそう}{地域|ちいき}に{平和維持軍|へいわいじぐん}を{派遣|はけん}している。
examples.english: The UN dispatches peacekeeping forces to conflict regions.

notes:
UN (United Nations / {国際|こくさい}{連合|れんごう} or {国連|こくれん}) is a major international organization. In Japanese, {国連|こくれん} is the most common abbreviation used.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- UN{総会|そうかい} / {国連|こくれん}{総会|そうかい}: UN General Assembly
- UN{安保理|あんぽり} / {国連|こくれん}{安全保障理事会|あんぜんほしょうりじかい}: UN Security Council
- UN{事務総長|じむそうちょう}: UN Secretary-General
- UN{難民|なんみん}{高等弁務官|こうとうべんむかん}: UN High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR)

UN is sometimes written in the English alphabet, but {国連|こくれん} is more common in Japanese text.
